title: Personal Guarantor Insolvency Cannot Proceed Independently of Corporate Debtor CIRP
summary: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal held that proceedings against a personal guarantor under Section 95 of the IBC cannot be admitted independently without corresponding CIRP proceedings against the principal corporate debtor.

title: IBBI Revises Resolution Professional Fee Structure Under CIRP Regulations
authority: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI)
summary: The IBBI has amended the Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons Regulations to revise the fee payable to Resolution Professionals, introducing performance-linked components and capping fees relative to the resolution value achieved.

title: Seat of Arbitration Confers Exclusive Supervisory Jurisdiction on Courts of That Place
summary: The Supreme Court reaffirmed that once a seat of arbitration is contractually designated, courts at that seat have exclusive supervisory jurisdiction. Courts at other venues cannot entertain challenges merely because a cause of action arose there.

title: MCA Tightens Registered Office Compliance — Physical Verification Mandated for Non-Compliant Companies
summary: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs has issued a circular directing Registrars of Companies to conduct physical verification of registered offices of companies that have defaulted on annual filing obligations, with consequences including striking off under Section 248 of the Companies Act, 2013.
